scripts.dev:services: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm --workspace apps/api run dev" "npm --workspace apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/api run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/web exec tsc -b
scripts.prisma:deploy: npm --workspace apps/api exec prisma migrate deploy
